template.label: Analog (create-analog)
template.description: A real create-analog app (Angular), production build served by Nitro
template.notes: Scaffolder runs at build time; installs npm 11.21.1 because the template's vite/vitest overrides fail on npm 10, and git because create-analog runs git init; builds at image build time and serves the Nitro production server, because the Vite dev server ran out of memory under flisk up.
